main.description: How the caller's own public profile matches a posting, as a coarse label. Requires service auth (lxm = this NSID); the caller is the token's issuer, and there is deliberately no parameter to ask about anyone else. Unknown parameters are refused.

label.description: A coarse band of the similarity between the two documents, not a percentage. Absent while pending.

matchedSkills.description: The posting's skills that the caller's profile also lists.

pending.description: The posting or the caller's profile has not been embedded yet.
